title: Incisional hernia repair
what: The surgeon pushes the bulge back inside and strengthens the weak spot in the scar with mesh. It can be open surgery or keyhole surgery.
why: When a hernia bulges through an old surgical scar, hurts, or grows.
duration: surgery usually takes 1 to 3 hours, with 2 to 5 days in hospital
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners and diabetes medicines. Your doctor will say what to stop and when
Heart or lung disease, or diabetes
If you smoke. Smoking slows healing

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and sometimes an ultrasound or CT of the belly. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Weight and smoking
prepare.text: If there is time, your doctor may advise losing weight and quitting smoking. This lowers the risk of the hernia coming back.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Abdominal binder
prepare.text: Ask if you need to buy an abdominal binder in advance, and what size.

bring: Documents and a list of your medicines
An abdominal binder, if you were told to
Things for a hospital stay of a few days
steps: You change, and an IV line is placed
The surgeon makes a cut or small punctures
The hernia contents are pushed back into the belly
The weak spot is strengthened with mesh
The wound is stitched. Sometimes a drain tube is placed
feel: Pain in the wound. You will get painkillers
A tight feeling in the belly
after: Wear the binder if your doctor prescribed it
No heavy lifting, usually for 1 to 3 months. Your surgeon will say how long
Hold the wound with your hand when you cough
red_flags: Severe, growing belly pain or vomiting: call emergency services
Redness, pus, or strong swelling of the wound
No stool or gas for more than a day, with bloating

faq.a: It strengthens the weak spot and lowers the risk of the hernia coming back.
Sometimes. The risk is lower if you avoid heavy lifting, weight gain, and smoking.

reminders.text: Hernia surgery tomorrow. Pack your documents, binder, and things. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
